entries.package.name: Mistland
entries.package.short: A small invented world of moors, rivers and lantern light. Good for trying things out.
entries.level.name: Level
entries.level.intro: Your level says how much your character has already lived through. A higher level means more knacks and more stamina.
entries.level.hint: Not sure? Ask your game leader. Otherwise, pick level 1.
entries.sheet.attribution: Mistland is an invented demo world. License: GNU AGPL 3.0. Fishing net: community addition, CC0.

entries.choice.folk.title: Folk
entries.choice.folk.question: Where does your character come from?
entries.choice.folk.intro: Your folk are the people you grew up with. They decide how fast you are and what you can do from birth.
entries.choice.upbringing.title: Upbringing
entries.choice.upbringing.question: Where did your character spend their childhood?
entries.choice.upbringing.intro: Your upbringing gives you 2 talents and one item.
entries.choice.calling.title: Calling
entries.choice.calling.question: How does your character earn a living?
entries.choice.calling.intro: Your calling decides what you do best at the table. It's the most important choice.
entries.choice.calling-gifts.title: What your calling gives you
entries.choice.calling-gifts.question: This is what you get from your calling
entries.choice.calling-gifts.intro: You get these things automatically. You don't have to choose anything.
entries.choice.talents-lantern-bearer.title: Talents
entries.choice.talents-lantern-bearer.question: What is your character trained in?
entries.choice.talents-lantern-bearer.intro: As a Lantern Bearer, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]]. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.talents-lantern-bearer.variant.hi: As a Lantern Bearer, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]], one more than others: the hillfolk learn a lot from their elders. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.talents-river-runner.title: Talents
entries.choice.talents-river-runner.question: What is your character trained in?
entries.choice.talents-river-runner.intro: As a River Runner, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]]. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.talents-river-runner.variant.hill: As a River Runner, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]], one more than others: the hillfolk learn a lot from their elders. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.talents-herbalist.title: Talents
entries.choice.talents-herbalist.question: What is your character trained in?
entries.choice.talents-herbalist.intro: As a Herbalist, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]]. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.talents-herbalist.variant.hillfol: As a Herbalist, you learn {{var:count}} [[glossary:talent|talents]], one more than others: the hillfolk learn a lot from their elders. Pick the ones that fit your character.
entries.choice.gear.title: Gear
entries.choice.gear.question: What else does your character take along?
entries.choice.gear.intro: Your calling already gives you tools. Here you pick one more piece.
entries.choice.knacks-lantern.title: Knacks
entries.choice.knacks-lantern.question: Which knacks does your character know?
entries.choice.knacks-lantern.intro: [[glossary:knack|Knacks]] are small wonders. You pick 2. From level 2 on, you pick 3.
entries.choice.knacks-current.title: Knacks
entries.choice.knacks-current.question: Which knacks does your character know?
entries.choice.knacks-current.intro: [[glossary:knack|Knacks]] are small wonders. You pick 2. From level 2 on, you pick 3.
entries.choice.borrowed-knack.title: Borrowed knack
entries.choice.borrowed-knack.question: Which knack have you picked up from others?
entries.choice.borrowed-knack.intro: From level 2 on, you learn one [[glossary:knack|knack]] from another calling. The list is long. Search for a name or let us suggest one.
entries.choice.knacks-root.title: Knacks
entries.choice.knacks-root.question: Which knacks does your character know?
entries.choice.knacks-root.intro: [[glossary:knack|Knacks]] are small wonders. You pick 2. From level 2 on, you pick 3.
entries.choice.path.title: Path
entries.choice.path.question: What has your character mastered?
entries.choice.path.intro: From level 3 on, you become a master of one thing in your calling.
entries.choice.scores.title: Scores
entries.choice.scores.question: What is your character good at?
entries.choice.scores.intro: You have 4 scores. Spread points across them. High scores help you with matching rolls.
entries.choice.extra-talent.title: New talent
entries.choice.extra-talent.question: What has your character learned on the road?
entries.choice.extra-talent.intro: From level 2 on, you learn one more [[glossary:talent|talent]]. You can take any one you don't have yet.
entries.choice.name.title: Name
entries.choice.name.question: What is your character's name?
entries.choice.name.intro: Make up a name you'll like hearing at the table. Or roll for a suggestion.
entries.choice.concept.title: In one sentence
entries.choice.concept.question: Describe your character in one sentence.
entries.choice.concept.intro: For example: "A quiet ferrywoman who knows every path through the fog." You may take a character from a film or book as a model. You can skip this.
entries.choice.age.title: Age
entries.choice.age.question: How old is your character?
entries.choice.age.intro: Age doesn't change any numbers. It helps you picture your character.
entries.choice.looks.title: Looks
entries.choice.looks.question: What does your character look like?
entries.choice.looks.intro: One or two sentences are enough. You can skip this.
entries.step.character.title: Your character
entries.step.character.question: Who is your character?
entries.step.character.intro: First, picture roughly who you want to play. The numbers come later. With every choice after this, you can ask: what fits my character?
entries.step.looks.title: Looks
entries.step.looks.question: How do you picture your character?
entries.step.looks.intro: Last, you give your character a face. This doesn't change any numbers.
entries.value.might.name: Might
entries.value.might.explain: How strong you are. Helps with carrying, lifting and pushing.
entries.value.grace.name: Grace
entries.value.grace.explain: How nimble and sure-footed you are. Helps you dodge.
entries.value.wit.name: Wit
entries.value.wit.explain: How fast you think and how much you know.
entries.value.heart.name: Heart
entries.value.heart.explain: How well you win people over and comfort them.
entries.value.mightBonus.name: Might bonus
entries.value.graceBonus.name: Grace bonus
entries.value.witBonus.name: Wit bonus
entries.value.heartBonus.name: Heart bonus
entries.value.stamina.name: Stamina
entries.value.stamina.explain: How much you can still take. See [[glossary:stamina|stamina]].
entries.value.guard.name: Guard
entries.value.guard.explain: How hard you are to hit. See [[glossary:guard|guard]].
entries.value.pace.name: Pace
entries.value.pace.explain: How far you move on your turn. See [[glossary:pace|pace]].
entries.value.luck.name: Luck tokens
entries.value.luck.explain: With a [[glossary:luck-token|luck token]], you redo a roll.
entries.value.nerve.name: Nerve bonus
entries.value.nerve.explain: You add this number when you need to overcome fear.
entries.value.carry.name: Carrying load
entries.value.carry.explain: This is how much you can carry without slowing down.

entries.sheet.how-to-play.title: Your turn
entries.sheet.how-to-play.text: 1. Say what your character wants to do. 2. The game leader says if you need to roll. 3. Roll and add the matching number. 4. The game leader tells you what happens.

entries.glossary.stamina.name: Stamina
entries.glossary.stamina.short: How much you can take before you have to give up.
entries.glossary.stamina.explain.what: Stamina is a number on your sheet. Every hit takes some of it away.
entries.glossary.stamina.explain.table: Write the number in pencil. When you get hit, erase it and write the new number. At 0, you can't keep fighting.
entries.glossary.stamina.explain.example: Example: You have 8 stamina. A wolf bites you for 3. Now you have 5.
entries.glossary.guard.name: Guard
entries.glossary.guard.short: How hard it is to hit you.
entries.glossary.guard.explain.what: Guard is a number on your sheet. The higher it is, the more often attacks miss.
entries.glossary.guard.explain.table: When someone attacks you, the game leader rolls. If the result is lower than your guard, the attack misses.
entries.glossary.guard.explain.example: Example: Your guard is 7. The game leader rolls a 5. The stone flies past you.
entries.glossary.pace.name: Pace
entries.glossary.pace.short: How far you move when it's your turn.
entries.glossary.pace.explain.what: Pace is a distance. It's how far you can move on your turn.
entries.glossary.pace.explain.table: In a fight, everyone takes turns. On your turn, you can move as far as your pace. Then you do one more thing.
entries.glossary.pace.explain.example: Example: Your pace is {{length:25}}. You run to the bridge and pull your friend up.
entries.glossary.luck-token.name: Luck Token
entries.glossary.luck-token.short: A token that lets you redo a bad roll.
entries.glossary.luck-token.explain.what: You get luck tokens for good ideas in play. You can hold up to 3.
entries.glossary.luck-token.explain.table: After a bad roll, hand in a token and roll again. The game leader gives you new ones when you do something brave or funny.
entries.glossary.luck-token.explain.example: Example: You roll a 2 while climbing. You hand in a luck token and roll a 14. You make it up.
entries.glossary.knack.name: Knack
entries.glossary.knack.short: A small wonder you can work a few times a day.
entries.glossary.knack.explain.what: A knack is something only you can do. Make light, call mist, make plants grow.
entries.glossary.knack.explain.table: Every knack has a card. On your turn, say which one you use. Then tick a box. When all boxes are full, wait for your next rest.
entries.glossary.knack.explain.example: Example: You use Warm Glow and tick a box. Your friend feels better right away.
entries.glossary.talent.name: Talent
entries.glossary.talent.short: Something you've practiced, so you're better at it.
entries.glossary.talent.explain.what: A talent is a thing you've learned. Climbing or tracking, for example.
entries.glossary.talent.explain.table: When you roll for something that fits one of your talents, add 2.
entries.glossary.talent.explain.example: Example: You know climbing. You roll a 9 and add 2. With 11, you get up the wall.
entries.glossary.rest.name: Rest
entries.glossary.rest.short: A break in the game where your character recovers.
entries.glossary.rest.explain.what: A rest is a quiet night or a long break by the fire.
entries.glossary.rest.explain.table: After a rest, erase the ticks on your knacks. Your stamina is full again.
entries.glossary.rest.explain.example: Example: You sleep in a hut. In the morning, you can use all your knacks again.
entries.glossary.dice.name: d6, d8
entries.glossary.dice.short: This is how we write which die to use.
entries.glossary.dice.explain.what: "d" means die. The number after it says how many sides it has. A number in front says how many to roll.
entries.glossary.dice.explain.table: If your card says "2d6", roll two six-sided dice and add them up.
entries.glossary.dice.explain.example: Example: "1d8 + 2" means: roll one eight-sided die and add 2.
entries.glossary.game-leader.name: Game leader
entries.glossary.game-leader.short: The person who runs the game and describes the world.
entries.glossary.game-leader.explain.what: One person at the table doesn't play a character of their own. They tell the story and play everyone else.
entries.glossary.game-leader.explain.table: They tell you when to roll. Ask them when you're stuck.
entries.folk.moorfolk.name: Moorfolk
entries.folk.moorfolk.short: You know every path through mist and mud.
entries.folk.moorfolk.goodIf: Good if you like moving quietly and surely.
entries.folk.moorfolk.explain.what: The moorfolk live in huts on stilts. They see farther in the mist than anyone else.
entries.folk.moorfolk.explain.table: In mist or darkness, you still see where you're going. Your pace is {{length:25}}.
entries.folk.moorfolk.explain.example: Example: The group gets lost in the mist. You lead them safely back to the path.
entries.folk.hillfolk.name: Hillfolk
entries.folk.hillfolk.short: You're as tough as the rock you grew up on.
entries.folk.hillfolk.goodIf: Good if you want to take a lot of hits.
entries.folk.hillfolk.explain.what: The hillfolk live high up among the stones. They're slow, but hard to knock down.
entries.folk.hillfolk.explain.table: You have 2 more [[glossary:stamina|stamina]]. You learn 1 more [[glossary:talent|talent]]. Your pace is only {{length:20}}.
entries.folk.hillfolk.explain.example: Example: A boulder hits you. You shake off the dust and keep walking.
entries.folk.coastfolk.name: Coastfolk
entries.folk.coastfolk.short: You're fast on land and at home in the water.
entries.folk.coastfolk.goodIf: Good if you want to be quick and nimble.
entries.folk.coastfolk.explain.what: The coastfolk live from fishing and trade. They swim as soon as they can walk.
entries.folk.coastfolk.explain.table: You can swim and hold your breath for a long time. Your pace is {{length:30}}.
entries.folk.coastfolk.explain.example: Example: A key falls into the harbor. You dive after it and bring it back.
entries.upbringing.ferry-child.name: Ferry Child
entries.upbringing.ferry-child.short: You grew up on a ferry, between wind and traders.
entries.upbringing.ferry-child.goodIf: Good if you like talking to people.
entries.upbringing.ferry-child.explain.what: Your family carried people across the river. You learned early to read the weather and to haggle.
entries.upbringing.ferry-child.explain.table: You get the talents Weather Sense and Haggling. You also get a rope. Swaying planks make you nimble: Grace +1.
entries.upbringing.bell-tower.name: Bell Tower
entries.upbringing.bell-tower.short: You grew up in the bell tower, among old books.
entries.upbringing.bell-tower.goodIf: Good if you like solving riddles.
entries.upbringing.bell-tower.explain.what: You helped the bell ringer and read old stories at night. You hear every quiet sound.
entries.upbringing.bell-tower.explain.table: You get the talents Legends and Listening. You also get a small bell.
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.name: Lantern Bearer
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.short: You bring light into the dark and keep the group together.
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.goodIf: Good if you like helping others.
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.explain.what: A calling for people who lead the way. You carry a lantern staff and know knacks that heal and protect.
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.explain.table: At the table, you often get others back on their feet. You rarely act alone. You help.
entries.calling.lantern-bearer.explain.example: Example: Your friend is down. You raise your lantern and give back 4 stamina.
entries.calling.river-runner.name: River Runner
entries.calling.river-runner.short: You're fast, nimble and know every current.
entries.calling.river-runner.goodIf: Good if you want to be in the middle of things.
entries.calling.river-runner.explain.what: A calling for people who steer boats and carry messages. You have a boat hook and knacks with water and mist.
entries.calling.river-runner.explain.table: At the table, you're often first to arrive. You can take a lot and get others out of danger.
entries.calling.river-runner.explain.example: Example: A raft drifts toward the waterfall. You jump over and steer it to the shore.
entries.calling.herbalist.name: Herbalist
entries.calling.herbalist.short: You know every plant and what it's good for.
entries.calling.herbalist.goodIf: Good if you'd rather think than rush in.
entries.calling.herbalist.explain.what: A calling for people who gather, mix and heal. You carry an herb satchel and make plants work for you.
entries.calling.herbalist.explain.table: At the table, you often have the right idea. Your knacks hold enemies in place or help with healing.
entries.calling.herbalist.explain.example: Example: A bear attacks. You make roots grow out of the ground. They hold it tight.
entries.path.lightwarden.name: Lightwarden
entries.path.lightwarden.short: Your light protects everyone standing close to you.
entries.path.lightwarden.goodIf: Good if you want to protect your group.
entries.path.lightwarden.explain.what: You've learned to hold your light like a shield.
entries.path.lightwarden.explain.table: Your guard goes up by 1. You learn the knack Lantern Call.
entries.path.ferrymaster.name: Ferrymaster
entries.path.ferrymaster.short: No river is too wild, no way too far.
entries.path.ferrymaster.goodIf: Good if you want to get the group there safely.
entries.path.ferrymaster.explain.what: You know every river in Mistland. The water talks to you.
entries.path.ferrymaster.explain.table: You never get lost on the water. You learn the knack River Voice.
entries.path.mushroom-whisperer.name: Mushroom Whisperer
entries.path.mushroom-whisperer.short: Mushrooms obey you and tell you what they've seen.
entries.path.mushroom-whisperer.goodIf: Good if you want to uncover secrets.
entries.path.mushroom-whisperer.explain.what: You've made friends with the mushrooms deep in the forest.
entries.path.mushroom-whisperer.explain.table: Spores can't hurt you. You learn the knack Spore Veil.
entries.talent.climbing.name: Climbing
entries.talent.climbing.short: You get up walls, trees and rocks.
entries.talent.climbing.explain.what: You know where to find a hold.
entries.talent.climbing.explain.table: When you climb, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.haggling.name: Haggling
entries.talent.haggling.explain.what: You can tell how much someone really wants.
entries.talent.haggling.explain.table: When you trade, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.tracking.name: Tracking
entries.talent.tracking.short: You find tracks and know who was here.
entries.talent.tracking.explain.what: A bent blade of grass tells you a story.
entries.talent.tracking.explain.table: When you look for tracks, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.mending.name: Mending
entries.talent.mending.short: You bandage wounds and know what helps.
entries.talent.mending.explain.what: You've learned to look after the injured.
entries.talent.mending.explain.table: When you tend to someone, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.listening.name: Listening
entries.talent.listening.explain.what: Steps, whispers, a creak in the wood: you hear it.
entries.talent.listening.explain.table: When you listen closely, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.legends.name: Legends
entries.talent.legends.short: You know the old stories of Mistland.
entries.talent.legends.explain.what: You've read a lot and listened even more.
entries.talent.legends.explain.table: When you try to remember something, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.sneaking.name: Sneaking
entries.talent.sneaking.explain.what: You know where the floor creaks and where it doesn't.
entries.talent.sneaking.explain.table: When you want to stay unseen, add 2 to your roll.
entries.talent.weather-sense.name: Weather Sense
entries.talent.weather-sense.short: You know when rain, storm or mist is coming.
entries.talent.weather-sense.explain.what: You read clouds, wind and birds.
entries.talent.weather-sense.explain.table: When you predict the weather, add 2 to your roll.
entries.trait.mist-sight.name: Mist Sight
entries.trait.mist-sight.short: Mist and dusk don't bother you.
entries.trait.mist-sight.explain.what: Your eyes are used to the mist.
entries.trait.mist-sight.explain.table: In mist or at dusk, you see as well as by day.
entries.trait.stone-steady.name: Steady as Stone
entries.trait.stone-steady.explain.what: You stand firm, even when the ground shakes.
entries.trait.stone-steady.explain.table: When something tries to knock you down, tell the game leader. You roll twice and take the better result. You can do this once per rest.
entries.trait.salt-blood.name: Salt Blood
entries.trait.salt-blood.short: You swim well and hold your breath for a long time.
entries.trait.salt-blood.explain.what: Water is like a second home to you.
entries.trait.salt-blood.explain.table: You can swim without rolling. Underwater, you last 10 minutes.
entries.trait.steady-flame.name: Steady Flame
entries.trait.steady-flame.explain.what: Wind and rain can't put out your light.
entries.trait.steady-flame.explain.table: Your lantern always shines, even in a storm or underwater.
entries.trait.quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
entries.trait.quick-feet.short: You're a bit faster than before.
entries.trait.quick-feet.explain.what: Many trips along the river have made your legs strong.
entries.trait.green-thumb.name: Green Thumb
entries.trait.green-thumb.short: Plants grow faster when you care for them.
entries.trait.green-thumb.explain.what: You can feel what a plant needs.
entries.trait.green-thumb.explain.table: After a rest, you always find enough herbs for a tea. Whoever drinks it gets 2 stamina back.
entries.trait.warding-glow.name: Warding Glow
entries.trait.warding-glow.explain.what: A soft glow always surrounds you.
entries.trait.ferry-sense.name: Ferry Sense
entries.trait.ferry-sense.short: You never get lost on the water.
entries.trait.ferry-sense.explain.what: You feel where the current is going.
entries.trait.ferry-sense.explain.table: On a river or lake, you always know where north is and where the nearest shore lies.
entries.trait.spore-friend.name: Spore Friend
entries.trait.spore-friend.short: Spores and mushroom poison can't hurt you.
entries.trait.spore-friend.explain.what: The mushrooms think you're one of them.
entries.trait.spore-friend.explain.table: Spore clouds and poisonous mushrooms can't harm you.
entries.knack.spark-shower.name: Spark Shower
entries.knack.spark-shower.short: A burst of bright sparks dazzles your enemies.
entries.knack.spark-shower.goodIf: Good if you want to hold enemies back.
entries.knack.spark-shower.explain.what: You shake your lantern. Sparks fly up to {{length:30}} away.
entries.knack.spark-shower.explain.table: On your turn, say: "I use Spark Shower." Anyone hit loses 1d6 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]] and can't see for a moment.
entries.knack.spark-shower.explain.example: Example: Three thieves stand in front of you. You make sparks rain down. They rub their eyes, and you run away.
entries.knack.glow-thread.name: Glow Thread
entries.knack.glow-thread.short: A glowing thread shows you the way back.
entries.knack.glow-thread.goodIf: Good if your group often gets lost.
entries.knack.glow-thread.explain.what: You stretch out a thread of light. It reaches up to {{length:60}} and glows for an hour.
entries.knack.glow-thread.explain.table: Say where the thread starts. While it glows, your group can always find the way back.
entries.knack.quiet-word.name: Quiet Word
entries.knack.quiet-word.short: A soft word calms people and animals.
entries.knack.quiet-word.goodIf: Good if you'd rather avoid a fight.
entries.knack.quiet-word.explain.what: You whisper a calming word to a living being up to {{length:10}} away.
entries.knack.quiet-word.explain.table: An angry animal or person calms down for 1 minute. The game leader tells you how they react.
entries.knack.warm-glow.name: Warm Glow
entries.knack.warm-glow.short: Your light warms and heals a friend.
entries.knack.warm-glow.goodIf: Good if you like helping others.
entries.knack.warm-glow.explain.what: You hold your lantern to someone who's hurt.
entries.knack.warm-glow.explain.table: Touch someone on your turn. They get 1d8 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]] back.
entries.knack.warm-glow.explain.example: Example: Your friend has only 2 stamina left. You roll a 6. Now they have 8.
entries.knack.shadow-ward.name: Shadow Ward
entries.knack.shadow-ward.goodIf: Good if you travel at night.
entries.knack.shadow-ward.explain.what: For 1 minute, you shine so brightly that shadow beings avoid you.
entries.knack.shadow-ward.explain.table: Beings made of shadow can't attack you during that time.
entries.knack.light-bridge.name: Light Bridge
entries.knack.light-bridge.short: A bridge of light carries you over gorges.
entries.knack.light-bridge.goodIf: Good if you often stand at the edge of a drop.
entries.knack.light-bridge.explain.what: You build a bridge of light up to {{length:40}} long. It holds for 1 minute.
entries.knack.light-bridge.explain.table: Your whole group can walk across. After 1 minute, it disappears.
entries.knack.lantern-call.name: Lantern Call
entries.knack.lantern-call.short: Your light calls all your friends to you.
entries.knack.lantern-call.explain.what: You raise your lantern high. Every friend up to {{length:100}} away sees the light.
entries.knack.lantern-call.explain.table: Everyone who sees the light may move toward you right away, up to their [[glossary:pace|pace]].
entries.knack.fog-hop.name: Fog Hop
entries.knack.fog-hop.short: You vanish into the fog and appear a short way off.
entries.knack.fog-hop.goodIf: Good if you want to get out of danger fast.
entries.knack.fog-hop.explain.what: A knack that moves you without walking. You land in a spot you can see, up to {{length:30}} away.
entries.knack.fog-hop.explain.table: On your turn, say: "I use Fog Hop." Point to where you land. Then tick a box.
entries.knack.fog-hop.explain.example: Example: Two guards trap you in an alley. You hop into the fog and suddenly stand on the roof.
entries.knack.eddy.name: Eddy
entries.knack.eddy.short: A swirl of water holds an enemy in place.
entries.knack.eddy.goodIf: Good if you want to slow enemies down.
entries.knack.eddy.explain.what: You make water swirl around an enemy up to {{length:20}} away.
entries.knack.eddy.explain.table: The enemy can barely move for 1 minute. Only a good roll gets them free.
entries.knack.driftwood-guard.name: Driftwood Guard
entries.knack.driftwood-guard.short: Driftwood floats over and protects you.
entries.knack.driftwood-guard.goodIf: Good if you often stand in front.
entries.knack.driftwood-guard.explain.what: Pieces of wood wrap around you like armor.
entries.knack.driftwood-guard.explain.table: For 1 minute, your [[glossary:guard|guard]] goes up by 2.
entries.knack.wave-push.name: Wave Push
entries.knack.wave-push.short: A wave pushes enemies away from you.
entries.knack.wave-push.explain.what: A wave rolls out from you, up to {{length:15}} far.
entries.knack.wave-push.explain.table: Anyone in the wave is pushed back {{length:10}} and loses 1d6 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]].
entries.knack.dew-breath.name: Dew Breath
entries.knack.dew-breath.short: A cool breath quenches thirst and fire.
entries.knack.dew-breath.goodIf: Good if you travel for a long time.
entries.knack.dew-breath.explain.what: You breathe on something you touch. It turns damp and cool.
entries.knack.dew-breath.explain.table: You can put out a small fire or fill a cup with water.
entries.knack.rapid-rush.name: Rapid Rush
entries.knack.rapid-rush.short: You rush along as fast as a wild stream.
entries.knack.rapid-rush.goodIf: Good if you want to be first everywhere.
entries.knack.rapid-rush.explain.what: For 1 minute, you move like flowing water.
entries.knack.river-voice.name: River Voice
entries.knack.river-voice.short: The river tells you what it has seen.
entries.knack.river-voice.explain.what: You put your hand in the water and listen, up to {{length:60}} up and down the river.
entries.knack.river-voice.explain.table: Ask the game leader what happened by the water in the last hour. They answer truthfully.
entries.knack.moss-bed.name: Moss Bed
entries.knack.moss-bed.short: Soft moss lets a friend sleep soundly.
entries.knack.moss-bed.explain.what: You touch the ground. A bed of moss grows there.
entries.knack.moss-bed.explain.table: Anyone who rests on it for an hour gets 1d8 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]] back.
entries.knack.thorn-ring.name: Thorn Ring
entries.knack.thorn-ring.short: A ring of thorns keeps enemies away.
entries.knack.thorn-ring.goodIf: Good if you want to defend yourself.
entries.knack.thorn-ring.explain.table: For 1 minute, anyone who pushes through the thorns loses 1d6 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]].
entries.knack.herb-scent.name: Herb Scent
entries.knack.herb-scent.short: A scent of herbs brings courage and clear thoughts.
entries.knack.herb-scent.goodIf: Good if you want to make others stronger.
entries.knack.herb-scent.explain.what: You crush herbs under a friend's nose.
entries.knack.herb-scent.explain.table: On their next roll, your friend adds 2.
entries.knack.root-grip.name: Root Grip
entries.knack.root-grip.short: Roots grow out of the ground and hold on tight.
entries.knack.root-grip.goodIf: Good if you want to hold enemies in place.
entries.knack.root-grip.explain.what: Roots reach for an enemy up to {{length:30}} away.
entries.knack.root-grip.explain.table: The enemy stays put for 1 minute. With a good roll, they tear free.
entries.knack.root-grip.explain.example: Example: A bear attacks. Roots hold it tight. You have time to flee.
entries.knack.mushroom-glow.name: Mushroom Glow
entries.knack.mushroom-glow.short: Glowing mushrooms light up a dark place.
entries.knack.mushroom-glow.explain.what: Mushrooms grow and glow soft blue, up to {{length:20}} around you.
entries.knack.mushroom-glow.explain.table: For an hour, it's bright enough to read.
entries.knack.spore-veil.name: Spore Veil
entries.knack.spore-veil.short: A cloud of spores hides your group.
entries.knack.spore-veil.explain.what: You open a mushroom. A thick cloud spreads {{length:15}} wide.
entries.knack.spore-veil.explain.table: For 1 minute, nobody can see through the cloud. You can hide inside it.
entries.item.lantern-staff.name: Lantern Staff
entries.item.lantern-staff.short: A staff with a lantern on top.
entries.item.lantern-staff.explain.what: It's a walking stick and a light in one.
entries.item.lantern-staff.explain.table: You need it for lantern knacks.
entries.item.boat-hook.name: Boat Hook
entries.item.boat-hook.short: A long pole with a hook.
entries.item.boat-hook.explain.what: You push off boats with it and pull things closer.
entries.item.boat-hook.explain.table: You can reach things that are a bit away.
entries.item.herb-satchel.name: Herb Satchel
entries.item.herb-satchel.explain.what: Lots of small pockets with dried plants.
entries.item.herb-satchel.explain.table: You need it for herb knacks.
entries.item.rope.name: Rope
entries.item.rope.explain.what: Twisted from hemp, it holds several people.
entries.item.rope.explain.table: For climbing, tying up and rescuing.
entries.item.small-bell.name: Small Bell
entries.item.small-bell.short: A bell from the tower you grew up in.
entries.item.small-bell.explain.table: When you ring it, your group hears you even in the mist.
entries.item.provisions.name: Provisions
entries.item.provisions.explain.what: Bread, cheese, dried fruit and a bottle.
entries.item.provisions.explain.table: Cross off one day each time you camp on the road.
entries.item.travel-cloak.name: Travel Cloak
entries.item.travel-cloak.short: A thick cloak that keeps out rain and blows.
entries.item.travel-cloak.goodIf: Good if you like staying warm and safe.
entries.item.reed-shield.name: Reed Shield
entries.item.reed-shield.short: A light shield of woven reeds.
entries.item.reed-shield.goodIf: Good if you often stand in front.
entries.item.trail-boots.name: Trail Boots
entries.item.trail-boots.short: Boots that help you move faster.
entries.item.trail-boots.goodIf: Good if you want to be quick.
entries.item.mortar.name: Mortar
entries.item.mortar.short: A stone bowl for crushing herbs.
entries.item.mortar.goodIf: Good if you want to mix healing drinks.
entries.item.mortar.explain.what: Bowl and pestle of smooth stone.
entries.item.mortar.explain.table: After a rest, you mix a drink with it. Whoever drinks it gets 1d6 [[glossary:stamina|stamina]] back.
entries.choice.handling-river-runner.title: Handling
entries.choice.handling-river-runner.question: Which things does your character know inside out?
entries.choice.handling-river-runner.intro: As a River Runner, you know 2 things inside out. Best pick things you carry.
entries.handling.lantern-staff.name: Lantern Staff
entries.handling.lantern-staff.short: You swing the lantern staff without making the light flicker.
entries.handling.lantern-staff.explain.what: You've practiced with the staff for many nights.
entries.handling.lantern-staff.explain.table: When you fight with the lantern staff, add 1 to your roll.
entries.handling.boat-hook.name: Boat Hook
entries.handling.boat-hook.short: You pull, push and hook with the boat hook like a third hand.
entries.handling.boat-hook.explain.what: On the river, you used it every day.
entries.handling.boat-hook.explain.table: When you pull something closer with the boat hook, add 1 to your roll.
entries.handling.rope.name: Rope
entries.handling.rope.short: You tie knots fast and safe, even in the dark.
entries.handling.rope.explain.what: You know a knot for everything: holding, letting go and rescuing.
entries.handling.rope.explain.table: When you need your rope, add 1 to your roll.
entries.handling.small-bell.name: Small Bell
entries.handling.small-bell.short: With your bell, you give signals your group understands.
entries.handling.small-bell.explain.what: Short, long, twice: every sound means something.
entries.handling.small-bell.explain.table: You can give your group a short message with the bell.
entries.handling.reed-shield.name: Reed Shield
entries.handling.reed-shield.short: You catch blows safely with the reed shield.
entries.handling.reed-shield.explain.what: You know how to hold the light shield at an angle.
entries.handling.reed-shield.explain.table: Once per fight, you block a hit with the shield completely.
entries.handling.trail-boots.name: Trail Boots
entries.handling.trail-boots.short: In your trail boots, you don't slip.
entries.handling.trail-boots.explain.what: You know every step on wet stone and moss.
entries.handling.trail-boots.explain.table: On slippery ground, you don't fall.
